name: 46131 · Franklin, IN
findings: ZIP 46131 (Franklin) has 149 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46131 (Franklin) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46131 (Franklin) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.
